build_steps.description: Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts
Install system packages: git, curl, pkg-config, libasound2-dev, libudev-dev, libwayland-dev, libxkbcommon-dev, ca-certificates, build-essential, libssl-dev
Copy setup_runtime.sh and repo_setup.sh from build context to /opt/benchmark/
Execute repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace with Bevy repository
Execute setup_runtime.sh to install Rust toolchain via rustup
Set Rust environment variables: RUSTUP_HOME, CARGO_HOME, PATH

copy_operations.purpose: Runtime setup script for Rust toolchain installation
Repository materialization script for Bevy project

runtime_profile.activation_command: export RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/rustup && export CARGO_HOME=/opt/cargo && export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"

notes: Evaluation assets (eval.sh, tests) are runtime-mounted verifier assets, not baked into the image. The /workspace directory is materialized during build by repo_setup.sh, not copied from the build context.
